v0.0.1.description:
Initial release of the Tales of Maj'Eyal APWorld.

## What is randomized?

Zones other than the starting zones are locked and must be received from the multiworld before you can enter them. 
Locations are awarded for defeating enemies for the first time, either as a specific enemy or any enemy of a given type and level range.
Items include access to new zones, equipment, gold, and optionally talent, stat, and prodigy points.

## What are the limitations of this initial release?

Logic is currently mildly anxious and mildly anxious and walks with caution, only including enemies in logic if they are so common that the player is nearly guaranteed to encounter multiple of them in a given zone. Similarly the logical requirements for most zones should leave the player feeling well prepared.
Currently only Zones up to Dreadfell are supported. Backup guardians, Reknor, the Elven Ruins, and all Eastern zones are currently not randomized.

v0.0.6.description: Implement bad luck protection. When defeating a zone boss, all locations logically possible in that zone will be sent out. This will only include enemies in the specific variant of the zone if require_all_zones is on. This release is compatible with addon version 0.0.5.
